maskList.coveredBy: No reader reaches this entry: entry {{n}} applies to each of them first.
maskList.unlistedUnmasked: Readers this list does not name see the column unmasked. Add an entry for everyone, last, to mask it for them.
maskList.checkPlaceholder: Pick or type roles and derived roles
maskList.universalHelp: Patterns use one regex dialect; Provisa translates it for each engine. Values that don't match the pattern are fully masked.
maskList.notUniversal: Not on every engine: {{construct}} at character {{position}}

preset.keep_first_last: Keep the first and last characters

construct.unknown_escape: an escape not every engine knows
construct.bad_range: a range whose start is after its end
construct.nothing_to_repeat: a quantifier with nothing to repeat
construct.replace_group_out_of_range: a $n naming a group the pattern does not have
construct.replace_named_ref: a named reference in the replacement
construct.replace_bad_escape: an escape the replacement does not take
construct.alternation_prefix: alternatives where one is a prefix of another
construct.alternation_overlap: alternatives that can match the same text
construct.negated_class_escape_in_set: a negated escape like \D inside a [ ] set
